urumqi-2017.notes: The catalogue's problem names F 'Gathering' and J 'Lowest Common' are Luogu's short names; the QOJ problem list (source 4) and the editorial (source 17) give 'Gathering Minerals' and 'Lowest Common Ancestors'. The eleven Luogu pages show no samples. The QOJ attachments (Statements (en), Tutorials (zh-cn)) and its standings are linked but not held. No document of this pack prints the contest date.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw the QOJ login form; our copy is now the contest's dashboard with its problem list.
